summary: A willing dead player within 50' must go directly to the caster; where they arrive is treated as where they died.

effects.subject: dead-target
effects.note: Must go directly to the caster; Summon Dead ends immediately on reaching the caster (E2). Polarity benefit: the target is willing.

effects.subject: dead-target
effects.note: Wherever the player is when Summon Dead ends is treated as where the player died (the text's only stated end is reaching the caster, E2).

requirements.note: Dead player has not moved more than 5' from where they died, or is at their respawn.

termination.note: Summon Dead immediately ends on reaching the caster.

clarifications.text: The place where Summon Dead ends is treated as the player's place of death.

open_questions: E3 says 'when Summon Dead ends', which may include ending other than by arrival (for example if the caster dies or the movement is interrupted); timing on-arrival used as the only end the text states.
